id: title:Gilbert09:retry nerdgraph gateway timeouts instead of failing the sync

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HTTP 408 (Request Timeout) to the set of transient errors treated as retryable, alongside 429 and 500+, potentially improving warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.reason: Adds HTTP 408 to the retryable status code set, alongside 429 and 500+, and includes a corresponding test. This could help PostHog's warehouse ingestion recover from transient gateway timeouts rather than failing permanently, potentially improving reliability of warehouse data syncs.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency of 408 responses encountered by PostHog's warehouse ingestion; this is not demonstrated by the code alone. No other hunks or broader context provided.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds status code 408 to the set of HTTP responses treated as retryable errors, alongside 429 and 500+; also adds a corresponding test case.
